title: Assembly of restricted transition and cocone fields
statement: Existence of a strict component of the restricted representing data

proof.text: Choose supported extensions of every testing object using exists_derivedOpen_testObject and the supplied over-site derived localizations. Construct the cartesian arrows, the open adjunction mate sigma and the canonical pullback comparisons.

Use bijective restriction on ordinary Hom to lift each restricted map uniquely. Compose this equivalence with h.stageEquiv or h.limitEquiv, the bijective cartesian restriction on supported pullback Hom, and conjugation by the testing isomorphism.

Lift testing arrows via ordinary Hom bijectivity. Injectivity of restriction gives naturality of the lifted maps. Original testing naturality, naturality of kappa and cancellation of the testing isomorphisms prove both new naturality fields. The generic conjugated-map calculation is proved locally in Lean.

Lift postcomposition by F.map and d.ι using L.map_comp and restriction injectivity. Apply h.stageMap and h.limitMap, then the cartesian open Hom transport square. Transport naturality accounts for testing-isomorphism conjugation. Fill stageQCoh and limitQCoh with the supplied hypotheses and package the eight fields. The arbitrary supplied e is not assumed coherent and is not used in the construction.

proof_origin.note: Complete Lean assembly from two strictly smaller cartesian geometric statements, using supported test objects; the signature is unchanged. Restoration repair by Y2, 2026-10-21: the private transport-square import now uses WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.PerfectHomOpenTransportSquare, the current declaration attached to the same proof dependency. The existing complete proof and all dependency nodes are retained.
